CustomField.description: Order-side mirror of QuoteLineItem.RLM_Approval__c (🟡 Manager, 🟠 Director, 🔴 VP; blank when no approval is needed). Bound in OrderEntitiesMapping so RLM_DefaultPricingProcedure, including its approval-flags overlay, can price Orders (for example getRenewableAssetsSummary in the renewal flow). Written by the overlay on every reprice; read-only for users.
CustomField.label: Approval
